sentences.text: 2024 ) vs In Re: Salma Mondal on 8 January, 2025

Sl. No.34
 akd
 [Allowed]
 C. R. M. (A) 34 of 2025

In Re: An application for anticipatory bail under Section
 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed on 02.01.2
 connection with Gangnapur Police Station Case No.143 of 2
 23.05.2024 under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Pena
 subsequently charge sheet submitted under 
 498A/306/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

And
 In Re: Salma Mondal
 ... ..
 Mr. Prabir Majumder
 Mr. Snehansu Majumder
 ... ... for the peti
 Mr. Partha Pratim Das
 Mr. Rahul Ganguly
 ... ... for the Stat
 1.
Heard learned Advocates for both the parties.
2. We have considered the materials on record.
Co-accused similarly circumstanced with the petitioner have been granted pre-arrest bail.
Under such circumstances, we are inclined to extend the same privilege to the petitioner also.

3. Accordingly, we direct in the event of arrest, the accused/petitioner, namely, Salma Mondal, be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten thousand only), with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and on further condition that the petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional court and pray for regular bail within four weeks from date.
Signed By : ARUP KUMAR DAS High Court of Calcutta 9 th of January 2025 04:39:01 PM 4.
The application for anticipatory bail is, thus, disposed of.
